Name: Jehizkiah, Son of Shallum
Summary: Jehizkiah, son of Shallum, was one of the heads of Ephraim who stood up against bringing Judah's captives into Samaria.
KeyStory: Jehizkiah the son of Shallum stood with the other heads against the returning host.
LifeLesson: Refusing to profit from a brother's captivity is itself obedience.
